headline: Bitcoin Drops Below $80,000 Amid Tech Sector Weakness and Hawkish Fed Stance
summary: Bitcoin fell below $80,000 as weakness in technology stocks led by Samsung and a hawkish Federal Reserve stance weighed on broader markets. Crypto futures recorded $356 million in liquidations.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization, serving as a key benchmark for investor sentiment in digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Risk-off sentiment across technology markets and liquidations in crypto futures pushed prices lower.

why_moved: Weakness in equity tech shares and expectations of sustained elevated interest rates triggered liquidations in leveraged crypto derivatives.
